t: Designed to meet extreme working demands via the TriTorsion system. TriTorsion is the combination of a double torsion zone in the Impaktor holder and also a torsion zone in the Impaktor bit. This system uses the torsion zones to absorb peak loads from modern impact drivers, protecting the drive tip and therefore dramatically extending the service life of the bits. Miniature diamond particles bite into the screw head preventing cam-out and reducing the contact pressure required, greatly delaying user fatigue in power tool applications. Colour-coded in accordance to profile and size, allowing for fast and easy selection. Can be used directly in the impact driver thanks to an extended torsion zone.
b: Suitable for Power Screwdrivers with Impact Mode
